name: GB energy supply margins
summary: No NESO or National Gas margin notices in force; last electricity margin call on 6 Oct
state: NESO issued an Electricity Margin Notice on 28 Sep, later cancelled, and called for extra generation on 6 Oct when the margin fell to 1.88 GW (New Civil Engineer; Energy Live News). Searches on 6 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice issued since.
for_you: Margin notices are routine signals to generators and rarely affect households. Power cuts from supply shortfalls are very unlikely at this level.
rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO or National Gas notices in force as of 6 Nov

sources.title: New Civil Engineer — NESO issued electricity margin notice for GB grid, before later cancelling it
Energy Live News — NESO calls for extra power as margin falls 1.88GW

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
